verses.en: Hearken, O ye people of my church, to whom the kingdom has been given; hearken ye and give ear to him who laid the foundation of the earth, who made the heavens and all the hosts thereof, and by whom all things were made which live, and move, and have a being.
verses.sm: Faalogo mai ia, outou e tagata o la’u ekalesia, o e ua tuu atu i ai le malo; ia outou faalogo mai ia ma uai mai o outou taliga ia te ia o lē na faataotoina le faavae o le lalolagi, o lē na faia le lagi ma ona ’au uma, ma o lē na faia mea uma e ola, ma gaoioi, ma i ai.

verses.en: And again I say, hearken unto my voice, lest death shall overtake you; in an hour when ye think not the summer shall be past, and the harvest ended, and your souls not saved.
verses.sm: Ma Ou te toe fai atu, faalogo mai ia i lo’u leo, ne’i manumalo le oti ia te outou; i se itula tou te lē manatunatu ai o le a mavae atu ai le taumafanafana, ma uma ai le seleselega, ma lē faaolaina ai o outou agaga.

verses.en: Listen to him who is the advocate with the Father, who is pleading your cause before him—
verses.sm: Faalogo ia ia te ia o lē o le fautua i le Tamā, o lē o loo augani lo outou faamoemoe i ona luma—

verses.en: Saying: Father, behold the sufferings and death of him who did no sin, in whom thou wast well pleased; behold the blood of thy Son which was shed, the blood of him whom thou gavest that thyself might be glorified;
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu: Le Tamā e, faauta i mafatiaga ma le oti o lē na lē faia e ia se agasala, o lē na e fiafia tele i ai; faauta i le toto o lou Atalii na faamaligiina, le toto o ia o lē na e tuu atu ina ia faamamaluina oe;

verses.en: Wherefore, Father, spare these my brethren that believe on my name, that they may come unto me and have everlasting life.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, le Tamā e, ia faasaoina i latou nei o o’u uso o e ua talitonu i lo’u igoa, ina ia mafai ona latou o mai ia te a’u ma maua le ola tumau e faavavau.

verses.en: Hearken, O ye people of my church, and ye elders listen together, and hear my voice while it is called today, and harden not your hearts;
verses.sm: Faalogo mai ia, outou e tagata o la’u ekalesia, ma faalogo faatasi mai outou toeaina, ma faalogo mai i lo’u leo a’o valaau atu i le aso, ma aua le faamaaaina o outou loto;

verses.en: For verily I say unto you that I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the light and the life of the world—a light that shineth in darkness and the darkness comprehendeth it not.
verses.sm: Aua e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o A’u o le Alefa ma le Omeka, o le amataga ma le gataaga, o le malamalama ma le ola o le lalolagi— o se malamalama ua susulu i le pouliuli ma ua lē malamalama i ai le pouliuli.

w.en: and the life of the world;

verses.en: I came unto mine own, and mine own received me not; but unto as many as received me gave I power to do many miracles, and to become the sons of God; and even unto them that believed on my name gave I power to obtain eternal life.
verses.sm: Na Ou sau i lo’u lava nuu, ma sa lē talia a’u e lo’u lava nuu; ae o le toatele o i latou o e na talia a’u na Ou tuu atu i ai le mana latou te faia ai vavega e tele, ma avea ai ma atalii o le Atua; ma o i latou na talitonu i lo’u igoa na Ou tuu atu lava i ai le mana latou te maua ai le ola e faavavau.

verses.en: And even so I have sent mine everlasting covenant into the world, to be a light to the world, and to be a standard for my people, and for the Gentiles to seek to it, and to be a messenger before my face to prepare the way before me.
verses.sm: Ma ua faapea lava ona Ou auina atu o la’u feagaiga e faavavau i le lalolagi, e avea o se malamalama i le lalolagi, ma avea o se tagavai mo lo’u nuu, ma Nuuese ia saili i ai, ma avea o se avefeau i luma o o’u mata e sauni le ala i o’u luma.

verses.en: Wherefore, come ye unto it, and with him that cometh I will reason as with men in days of old, and I will show unto you my strong reasoning.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ia outou o mai i ai, ma o le a Ou filifili faatasi ma ia o lē e sau e pei ona Ou faia ma tagata i aso anamua, ma o le a Ou faaali atu ia te outou le malosi o lo’u manatu.

w.en: And I will show unto you

verses.en: Wherefore, hearken ye together and let me show unto you even my wisdom—the wisdom of him whom ye say is the God of Enoch, and his brethren,
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ia outou faalogo mai faatasi ma tuu mai ia te a’u e faailoa atu ia te outou lo’u poto lava— o le poto lea o ia o lē ua outou fai mai o le Atua o Enoka, ma ona uso,

verses.en: Who were separated from the earth, and were received unto myself—a city reserved until a day of righteousness shall come—a day which was sought for by all holy men, and they found it not because of wickedness and abominations;
verses.sm: O e na vavae ese mai le lalolagi, ma na Ou talia mo a’u lava— o se aai ua faasaoina seia oo mai se aso o le amiotonu— o se aso lea sa saili i ai tagata paia uma, ma sa latou lē mauaina ona o le amioleaga ma mea inosia;

verses.en: And confessed they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth;
verses.sm: Ma latou fai mai ai o i latou o ni tagata ese ma e ua aumau i luga o le lalolagi;

verses.en: But obtained a promise that they should find it and see it in their flesh.
verses.sm: Peitai sa latou maua se folafolaga o le a latou mauaina ma vaai i ai i o latou tino.

verses.en: Wherefore, hearken and I will reason with you, and I will speak unto you and prophesy, as unto men in days of old.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, faalogo mai ma o le a Ou talatala faatasi ma outou, ma o le a Ou tautala atu ia te outou ma vavalo atu, e pei ona faia i tagata i aso anamua.

verses.en: And I will show it plainly as I showed it unto my disciples as I stood before them in the flesh, and spake unto them, saying: As ye have asked of me concerning the signs of my coming, in the day when I shall come in my glory in the clouds of heaven, to fulfil the promises that I have made unto your fathers,
verses.sm: Ma o le a Ou faaalia manino atu e pei ona sa Ou faaalia atu i o’u soo a’o Ou tulai i o latou luma i le tino, ma tautala atu ia te i latou, ua fai atu: Ona ua outou ole mai ia te a’u e uiga i faailoga o lo’u sau, i le aso pe a Ou alu atu i lo’u mamalu i ao o le lagi, e faataunuu ai folafolaga na Ou faia i o outou tamā,

verses.en: For as ye have looked upon the long absence of your spirits from your bodies to be a bondage, I will show unto you how the day of redemption shall come, and also the restoration of the scattered Israel.
verses.sm: Aua e pei ona outou vaai i le umi o le o ese o o outou agaga mai i o outou tino o se nofopologa, o le a Ou faaali atu ai ia te outou le ala o le a oo mai ai le aso o le togiolaina, ma le toefuataiga foi o Isaraelu ua faataapeapeina.

verses.en: And now ye behold this temple which is in Jerusalem, which ye call the house of God, and your enemies say that this house shall never fall.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, ua outou vaai i lenei malumalu ua i Ierusalema, lea ua outou ta’ua o le maota o le Atua, ma ua fai mai o outou fili o le a lē pa’ū lava lenei fale.

verses.en: But, verily I say unto you, that desolation shall come upon this generation as a thief in the night, and this people shall be destroyed and scattered among all nations.
verses.sm: Ae, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o le a oo mai faatafunaga i luga o lenei tupulaga e pei o se gaoi i le po, ma o le a faaumatia lenei nuu ma faataapeapeina i totonu o atunuu uma.

verses.en: And this temple which ye now see shall be thrown down that there shall not be left one stone upon another.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei malumalu ua outou vaai atu nei i ai o le a soloia i lalo o le a lē tuua se tasi maa e taatia i luga o se isi maa.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that this generation of Jews shall not pass away until every desolation which I have told you concerning them shall come to pass.
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo mai, o le a lē mavae atu lenei tupulaga o tagata Iutaia seia faataunuuina faatafunaga uma na Ou fai atu ai ia te outou e faatatau ia te i latou.

w.en: And it shall come to pass,

verses.en: Ye say that ye know that the end of the world cometh; ye say also that ye know that the heavens and the earth shall pass away;
verses.sm: Ua outou fai mai ua outou iloa o le a oo mai le iuga o le lalolagi; ua outou fai mai foi ua outou iloa o le a mavae atu le lagi ma le lalolagi;

verses.en: And in this ye say truly, for so it is; but these things which I have told you shall not pass away until all shall be fulfilled.
verses.sm: Ma i lenei mea, ua moni la outou upu, ona ua faapea lava; ae o nei mea ua Ou ta’u atu ia te outou o le a lē mavae atu seia faataunuuina mea uma.

verses.en: And this I have told you concerning Jerusalem; and when that day shall come, shall a remnant be scattered among all nations;
verses.sm: Ma ua Ou ta’u atu ia te outou lenei mea e faatatau ia Ierusalema; ma a oo mai lena aso, o le a faataapeapeina se vaega o totoe i atunuu uma;

verses.en: But they shall be gathered again; but they shall remain until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.
verses.sm: Peitai o le a toe faapotopoto mai i latou; ae o le a latou nonofo pea seia faataunuuina aso o Nuuese.

verses.en: And in that day shall be heard of wars and rumors of wars, and the whole earth shall be in commotion, and men's hearts shall fail them, and they shall say that Christ delayeth his coming until the end of the earth.
verses.sm: Ma i lena aso o le a faalogoina ai taua ma tala o taua, ma o le a vāvāō le lalolagi atoa, ma o le a faavaivaia loto o tagata, ma o le a latou fai mai ua tolopo e Keriso lona afio mai seia oo i le iuga o le lalolagi.

verses.en: And the love of men shall wax cold, and iniquity shall abound.
verses.sm: Ma o le a faasolo maluluina le alofa o tagata, ma o le a faateteleina le amioletonu.

verses.en: And when the times of the Gentiles is come in, a light shall break forth among them that sit in darkness, and it shall be the fulness of my gospel;
verses.sm: Ma a oo mai taimi o Nuuese, o le a susulu atu se malamalama i totonu o i latou o e o nonofo i le pouliuli, ma o le atoatoaga lea o la’u talalelei;

verses.en: But they receive it not; for they perceive not the light, and they turn their hearts from me because of the precepts of men.
verses.sm: Peitai latou te lē taliaina; ona latou te lē iloaina le malamalama, ma ua latou liliu ese o latou loto mai ia te a’u ona o mataupu a tagata.

verses.en: And in that generation shall the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.
verses.sm: Ma o le tupulaga lena o le a faataunuuina ai taimi o Nuuese.

verses.en: And there shall be men standing in that generation, that shall not pass until they shall see an overflowing scourge; for a desolating sickness shall cover the land.
verses.sm: Ma o le a i ai ni tagata e tutulai i lena tupulaga o le a lē mavae atu seia latou vaai i se faasalaga tele naua; ona o le a ufitia le laueleele i se faamai faatafunaina.

verses.en: But my disciples shall stand in holy places, and shall not be moved; but among the wicked, men shall lift up their voices and curse God and die.
verses.sm: Ae o o’u soo o le a tutulai i nofoaga paia, ma o le a lē masii lava; ae i totonu o e e amioleaga, o le a siitia a’e i luga e tagata o latou leo ma upuleaga le Atua ma feoti ai.

verses.en: And there shall be earthquakes also in divers places, and many desolations; yet men will harden their hearts against me, and they will take up the sword, one against another, and they will kill one another.
verses.sm: Ma o le a i ai foi mafuie i nofoaga eseese, ma faatafunaga e tele; peitai o le a faamaaa e tagata o latou loto faasaga mai ia te a’u, ma o le a latou siia’e i luga le pelu, o le tasi e faasaga i le isi, ma o le a latou fasioti o le tasi i le isi.

verses.en: And now, when I the Lord had spoken these words unto my disciples, they were troubled.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, ina ua tautala atu e A’u o le Alii nei upu i o’u soo, sa latou atuatuvale.

verses.en: And I said unto them: Be not troubled, for, when all these things shall come to pass, ye may know that the promises which have been made unto you shall be fulfilled.
verses.sm: Ma sa Ou fai atu ia te i latou: Aua tou te atuatuvale, aua, a faataunuuina nei mea uma, o le a mafai ona outou iloa o le a faataunuuina folafolaga na fai atu ia te outou.

verses.en: And when the light shall begin to break forth, it shall be with them like unto a parable which I will show you—
verses.sm: Ma a amata ona susulu atu o le malamalama, o le a i ai faatasi ma i latou e pei o se faataoto o le a Ou faaali atu ia te outou—

verses.en: Ye look and behold the fig trees, and ye see them with your eyes, and ye say when they begin to shoot forth, and their leaves are yet tender, that summer is now nigh at hand;
verses.sm: Tou te vaai ma iloa atu laau o mati, ma e tou te vaai atu ia te i latou i o outou mata, ma tou fai ane pe a amata ona latou totogo a’e, ma a’o mu’amu’a pea o latou lau, ua lata mai nei le tau mafanafana;

verses.en: Even so it shall be in that day when they shall see all these things, then shall they know that the hour is nigh.
verses.sm: O le a faapea lava ona i ai i lena aso pe a latou vaai i nei mea uma, ona latou iloa ai lea ua lata mai le itula.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass that he that feareth me shall be looking forth for the great day of the Lord to come, even for the signs of the coming of the Son of Man.
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo mai o le a tulimatai i luma o ia o lē e mata’u ia te a’u mo le oo mai o le aso tele o le Alii, e oo lava i faailoga o le afio mai o le Atalii o le Tagata.

w.en: And it shall come to pass,

verses.en: And they shall see signs and wonders, for they shall be shown forth in the heavens above, and in the earth beneath.
verses.sm: Ma o le a latou vaai i faailoga ma mea e ofo ai, ona o le a faaalia i latou i le lagi i luga, ma i le lalolagi o i lalo.

verses.en: And they shall behold blood, and fire, and vapors of smoke.
verses.sm: Ma o le a latou vaaia le toto, ma le afi, ma le puao o le asu.

verses.en: And before the day of the Lord shall come, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon be turned into blood, and the stars fall from heaven.
verses.sm: Ma ae lei oo mai le aso o le Alii, o le a faapouliuligia le la, ma gasetoto le masina, ma o le a pa’u’ū ifo fetu mai le lagi.

verses.en: And the remnant shall be gathered unto this place;
verses.sm: Ma o le a faapotopoto mai le vaega o totoe i lenei nofoaga;

verses.en: And then they shall look for me, and, behold, I will come; and they shall see me in the clouds of heaven, clothed with power and great glory; with all the holy angels; and he that watches not for me shall be cut off.
verses.sm: Ma ona latou vaavaai lea mo a’u, ma, faauta, o le a Ou sau; ma o le a latou vaaia a’u i ao o le lagi, ua faaofuina i le mana ma le mamalu tele; faatasi ma agelu paia uma; ma o ia o lē e lē vaavaai mo a’u o le a vavae ese.

verses.en: But before the arm of the Lord shall fall, an angel shall sound his trump, and the saints that have slept shall come forth to meet me in the cloud.
verses.sm: Peitai ae lei pa’ū mai le aao o le Alii, o le a ilia e se agelu lana pu, ma o le a tutulai mai le au paia o e na momoe e faafetaiai a’u i le ao.

verses.en: Wherefore, if ye have slept in peace blessed are you; for as you now behold me and know that I am, even so shall ye come unto me and your souls shall live, and your redemption shall be perfected; and the saints shall come forth from the four quarters of the earth.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, afai na outou momoe i le filemu, amuia outou; ona e pei ona outou vaai mai nei ia te a’u ma iloa ua Ou i ai, o le a faapea lava ona outou o mai ia te a’u ma ola ai o outou agaga, ma o le a faaatoatoaina lo outou togiolaina; ma o le a o mai le au paia mai i itu e fa o le lalolagi.

verses.en: Then shall the arm of the Lord fall upon the nations.
verses.sm: Ona pa’ū mai ai lea o le aao o le Alii i luga o atunuu.

verses.en: And then shall the Lord set his foot upon this mount, and it shall cleave in twain, and the earth shall tremble, and reel to and fro, and the heavens also shall shake.
verses.sm: Ma ona afio a’e lea o le Alii i luga o le mauga lenei, ma o le a vaeluaina, ma o le a gatete le lalolagi, ma malualua solo, ma o le a luluina foi le lagi.

verses.en: And the Lord shall utter his voice, and all the ends of the earth shall hear it; and the nations of the earth shall mourn, and they that have laughed shall see their folly.
verses.sm: Ma o le a tulei mai e le Alii lona siufofoga, ma o le a lagona e tuluiga uma o le lalolagi; ma o le a laue faavauvau atunuu uma o le lalolagi, ma o i latou o e na toē o le a vaai i lo latou valea.

verses.en: And calamity shall cover the mocker, and the scorner shall be consumed; and they that have watched for iniquity shall be hewn down and cast into the fire.
verses.sm: Ma o le a ufitia i mala lē e tauemu, ma o lē e ’amu’amu o le a faaumatia; ma o i latou o e na vaavaai mo le amioletonu o le a taia i lalo ma lafo i le afi.

verses.en: And then shall the Jews look upon me and say: What are these wounds in thine hands and in thy feet?
verses.sm: Ma ona vaai mai ai lea o tagata Iutaia i luga ia te a’u ma fai mai: O a ia manua ua i ou lima ma ou vae?

verses.en: Then shall they know that I am the Lord; for I will say unto them: These wounds are the wounds with which I was wounded in the house of my friends. I am he who was lifted up. I am Jesus that was crucified. I am the Son of God.
verses.sm: Ona latou iloa lea o A’u o le Alii; ona o le a Ou fai atu ia te i latou: O nei manua, o manua ia na Ou manua ai i le fale o a’u uo. O A’u o lē na siitia a’e i luga. O A’u o Iesu o lē na faasatauroina. O A’u o le Atalii o le Atua.

verses.en: And then shall they weep because of their iniquities; then shall they lament because they persecuted their king.
verses.sm: Ma ona latou fetagisi ai lea ona o a latou amioletonu; ona latou tagiauē ai lea ona ua latou sauaina lo latou tupu.

verses.en: And then shall the heathen nations be redeemed, and they that knew no law shall have part in the first resurrection; and it shall be tolerable for them.
verses.sm: Ma ona togiolaina ai lea o atunuu faapaupau, ma o i latou o e sa latou lē iloa se tulafono o le a i ai sa latou vaega i le uluai toetutu; ma o le a gafatia e i latou.

verses.en: And Satan shall be bound, that he shall have no place in the hearts of the children of men.
verses.sm: Ma o le a noatia Satani, o le a lē maua ai e ia se nofoaga i totonu o loto o le fanauga a tagata.

verses.en: And at that day, when I shall come in my glory, shall the parable be fulfilled which I spake concerning the ten virgins.
verses.sm: Ma i lena aso, pe a Ou alu atu i lo’u mamalu, o le a faataunuu ai le faataoto na Ou tautala atu ai e faatatau i taupou e toasefulu.

verses.en: For they that are wise and have received the truth, and have taken the Holy Spirit for their guide, and have not been deceived—verily I say unto you, they shall not be hewn down and cast into the fire, but shall abide the day.
verses.sm: Aua o i latou o e e popoto ma ua latou talia le upumoni, ma ua latou ave le Agaga Paia mo o latou taiala, ma sa lei faaseseina— e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o le a lē taia i latou ma lafo i le afi, ae o le a latou gafatia le aso.

verses.en: And the earth shall be given unto them for an inheritance; and they shall multiply and wax strong, and their children shall grow up without sin unto salvation.
verses.sm: Ma o le a tuu atu ia te i latou le lalolagi e fai mo so latou tofi; ma o le a latou uluuluola ma faasolo malolosi, ma o le a tutupu a’e i le olataga a latou fanau e aunoa ma le agasala.

verses.en: For the Lord shall be in their midst, and his glory shall be upon them, and he will be their king and their lawgiver.
verses.sm: Ona o le a i ai le Alii i lo latou lotolotoi, ma o le a i ai lona mamalu i luga o i latou, ma o le a avea o ia ma o latou tupu ma o latou faitulafono.

verses.en: And now, behold, I say unto you, it shall not be given unto you to know any further concerning this chapter, until the New Testament be translated, and in it all these things shall be made known;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, faauta, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o le a lē tuu atu ia te outou ia outou iloa atili ni isi mea e faatatau i lenei mataupu, seia faaliliuina le Feagaiga Fou, ma o ona totonu o le a faailoa atu ai ia mea uma;

verses.en: Wherefore I give unto you that ye may now translate it, that ye may be prepared for the things to come.
verses.sm: O le mea lea Ou te tuu atu ia te oe ia mafai nei ona e faaliliuina, ina ia mafai ona outou saunia mo mea o le a oo mai.

verses.en: For verily I say unto you, that great things await you;
verses.sm: Aua e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, e i ai mea sili o loo faatali mai mo outou;

verses.en: Ye hear of wars in foreign lands; but, behold, I say unto you, they are nigh, even at your doors, and not many years hence ye shall hear of wars in your own lands.
verses.sm: Ua outou faalogo i taua i laueleele ese; ae, faauta, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ua lata mai i latou, ua i o outou faitotoa lava, ma e lē tele ni tausaga mai le taimi nei ae o le a outou faalogo i taua i o outou lava laueleele.

verses.en: Wherefore I, the Lord, have said, gather ye out from the eastern lands, assemble ye yourselves together ye elders of my church; go ye forth into the western countries, call upon the inhabitants to repent, and inasmuch as they do repent, build up churches unto me.
verses.sm: O le mea lea o A’u, o le Alii, na Ou fai atu ai, ia outou faapotopoto i fafo mai itu- laueleele i sasae, ia outou faapotopoto faatasi outou lava o toeaina o la’u ekalesia; ia outou o atu i itu-laueleele i sisifo, valaau atu i e o nonofo ai ia salamo, ma e tusa ai ma lo latou salamo, ia atia’e ai i luga aulotu ia te a’u.

verses.en: And with one heart and with one mind, gather up your riches that ye may purchase an inheritance which shall hereafter be appointed unto you.
verses.sm: Ma ia faaputuputu faatasi a outou oa ma le loto e tasi ma le mafaufau e tasi, ina ia mafai ona outou faatauina se tofi o le a tuu atu ia te outou pe a mavae le taimi nei.

verses.en: And it shall be called the New Jerusalem, a land of peace, a city of refuge, a place of safety for the saints of the Most High God;
verses.sm: Ma o le a ta’ua o le Ierusalema Fou, o se laueleele o le filemu, o se aai o le sulufaiga, o se nofoaga o le saogalemu mo le au paia a le Atua Silisili Ese;

verses.en: And the glory of the Lord shall be there, and the terror of the Lord also shall be there, insomuch that the wicked will not come unto it, and it shall be called Zion.
verses.sm: Ma o le a i ai iina le mamalu o le Alii, ma o le i ai iina le mata’u o le Alii, e oo ina lē o mai i ai o e amioleaga, ma o le a ta’ua o Siona.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass among the wicked, that every man that will not take his sword against his neighbor must needs flee unto Zion for safety.
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo mai i e e amioleaga, o tagata taitoatasi e lē siia’e lana pelu e faasaga i lē la te tuaoi, e ao ina sola i Siona mo le saogalemu.

w.en: And it shall come to pass,

verses.en: And there shall be gathered unto it out of every nation under heaven; and it shall be the only people that shall not be at war one with another.
verses.sm: Ma o iina o le a faapotopoto i ai tagata mai fafo o atunuu uma i lalo o le lagi; ma o le a nao le pau ia o tagata o le a lē tau le tasi ma le isi.

verses.en: And it shall be said among the wicked: Let us not go up to battle against Zion, for the inhabitants of Zion are terrible; wherefore we cannot stand.
verses.sm: Ma o le a faapea ane i totonu o e e amioleaga: Aua tatou te o a’e i luga e tau faasaga ia Siona, ona ua matua matautia lava tagata o Siona; o le mea lea e lē mafai ai ona tatou tutu.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass that the righteous shall be gathered out from among all nations, and shall come to Zion, singing with songs of everlasting joy.
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo mai o le a faapotopoto mai e e amiotonu mai atunuu uma, ma o le a o mai i Siona, ma pepese i pese o le olioli e tumau e faavavau.

w.en: And it shall come to pass,

verses.en: And now I say unto you, keep these things from going abroad unto the world until it is expedient in me, that ye may accomplish this work in the eyes of the people, and in the eyes of your enemies, that they may not know your works until ye have accomplished the thing which I have commanded you;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ia taofi nei mea mai le oo atu i le lautele o le lalolagi seia oo ina tatau ai ia te a’u, ina ia mafai ona outou faataunuuina lenei galuega i luma o mata o tagata, ma i luma o mata o o outou fili, ina ia latou lē iloa a outou galuega seia outou faataunuuina le mea ua Ou poloaiina ai outou;

w.en: before the eyes of the people,

verses.en: That when they shall know it, that they may consider these things.
verses.sm: Ona a oo ina latou iloaina, ia mafai ona latou manatunatu i nei mea.

verses.en: For when the Lord shall appear he shall be terrible unto them, that fear may seize upon them, and they shall stand afar off and tremble.
verses.sm: Ona a afio mai le Alii o le a matautia tele o ia ia te i latou, ina ia maua i latou i le mata’u, ma o le a latou tutulai mamao ese ma gatete.

verses.en: And all nations shall be afraid because of the terror of the Lord, and the power of his might. Even so. Amen.
verses.sm: Ma o le a matata’u atunuu uma ona o le matautia o le Alii, ma le mana o lona malosi. E faapea lava. Amene.
